change_summary: Replaced hardcoded grid tuple `(triton.cdiv(xnumel, 128), triton.cdiv(ynumel, 8))` with a lambda `lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, meta['XBLOCK']), triton.cdiv(ynumel, meta['YBLOCK']))` so the launch grid properly reflects the autotuner's selected XBLOCK/YBLOCK config instead of always evaluating to (1, 48).
